simcal_observe — SIMCAL model op

• 数据种类:simmodel × images → simmodel

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.simcal_observe(model=None, images=None, roi=None, align=False, exposure=None, max_shift=8, split='train') -> 'dict'(要直接调用实现,import simcal; simcal.simcal_observe(model=None, images=None, roi=None, align=False, exposure=None, max_shift=8, split='train') -> 'dict';从台账取用则 opssimcal.get("simcal_observe"))

用法

将实测图像附加到 simmodel：配准、感兴趣区域与曝光归一化。

> 以下的详细说明为原文 —— 摘要与标题已翻译。

images — one 2-D array per condition (shape = what the model outputs). align=True registers each image to the simulation at the initial knobs by phase correlation (filters_freq.phase_correlation_fft, integer pixels), shifts it back and masks the wrapped border; a shift larger than max_shift is refused. roi = boolean mask or (row0, row1, col0, col1). exposure = a factor per image to divide by (the noise variance is divided by its square) — refused when the model has a free gain knob: the two scale the same signal. split labels the data train / holdout / locked (the TRAIN / OBSERVED / LOCKED discipline of robust.py). Returns a new simmodel with observed filled (the input is not modified), including data_range.
